== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Rennek (V) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p4-76-Rennek.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-rennek-pre.gif]]) show the original text.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type, 2012-12-12 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html; same text in the capture of 11 January 2013). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “May be stacked on I Know That Laugh from hand for 2 force. While stacked on I Know That Laugh, stack face-up and during any battle may draw destiny. If destiny < number of your aliens in battle, reduce a participating character's forfeit to 0.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1282_19</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
